title: Bill 87 extending temporary structure permits to five years
summary: Bill 87 would let temporary structures allowed under an emergency proclamation remain in place for up to five years. At its July 19, 2024 meeting, the council postponed County Communication 24-23, a proposed amendment to Bill 87, until it takes up the bill itself. One testifier said Bills 87, 105 and 110 would help provide temporary housing.
